        # = -2 * (R_mat * V * W) contracted appropriately
        # For each i, r: sum over j,k of R_mat[i,j,k] * V[j,r] * W[k,r]
        # This is: for each i, (R_mat[i] * V) contracted with W along the last axis
        # Let's compute: RVW[i, r] = sum_{j,k} R_mat[i,j,k] * V[j,r] * W[k,r]
        # = sum_j (sum_k R_mat[i,j,k] * W[k,r]) * V[j,r]
